User.title: User
User.description: Represents an authenticated user and their personal hydration tracking history.

id.description: The unique Firebase Authentication UID of the user.

validatedDates.description: List of validated hydration date keys in YYYY-MM-DD format.

reminderEnabled.description: Whether the 20h evening reminder is enabled.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user account profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user account profile was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: User document containing account info and hydration tracking dates. Restricted strictly to the authenticated user.
